title: Loading a Pixar USDZ File
description: Loads a Pixar USDZ package and views it. USDZ is a ZIP wrapping a binary USD Crate (.usdc); the example fetches the .usdz bytes, creates a SceneModel, and drives USDZLoader directly (which unpacks the ZIP and decodes the crate with the tinyusdz wasm reader), then frames the camera. The sample is a Sketchfab residential-building export of ~140 meshes. Browser only.
